verdict.rationale: Martin's docs say he is reachable by phone and show users calling him and talking ("Call Martin and say 'Note down everything we talked about on this call...'"). He can also call users for wake-up briefings, so live two-way voice conversation is a documented interface. Missing for 10: any documentation of conversational quality (latency, natural turn-taking, interruptions), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the voice calls feel natural and real-time.
